# Set Up Shop Online

Handle More Business. Keep More of the Upside.

Vlad Gutenmakher, AI Consultant and Value Architect, helps established professional-service firms and specialized services handle more work profitably, create capacity, and reduce owner dependence. He brings more than 35 years across technology, engineering, solution architecture, technical sales, consulting, and implementation, plus approximately 20 years of entrepreneurship.

The method is Diagnose, Prioritize, Architect, Implement, and Measure. AI and agentic systems are used where they create meaningful business value.

## Entry paths

The free Business Strategy Report assessment offers six business priority paths with ten questions per assessment. It produces an AI-generated report with findings and a 30–60–90-day plan. No purchase or review call is required.

The 15-minute intro is for sharing a business priority, discussing fit, and identifying an appropriate next step. It does not include a written assessment, blueprint, implementation, or Opportunity Summary. The existing one-hour AI Strategy Session is a separate catalog service.
